SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
S.2, Special Branch
REPORT
Date October 14, 1934.

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
File No. S. B. REGISTRY.
No. D 6178

Subject (in full) Local Yugoslavian community - possibility of anti-Italian
or anti-French demonstrations in connection with the
assassination of King Alexander.

Made by D.S.I. Prokofiev Forwarded by [Signature]

At 1 p.m. on October 13, Dr. J.P. Ryabine and Mr.
Bechich, who are regarded as unofficial representatives of the
local Yugoslavian community, were interviewed by the undersigned
in order to ascertain whether or not there is any possibility
of demonstrations of an anti-Italian or anti-French character
on the part of their nationals in Shanghai in connection with
the assassination of King Alexander of Yugoslavia.

They stated that the total number of Yugoslaves in
Shanghai, including women and children, does not exceed 50, and
that with a few exceptions they are persons of very small means.
They also are peaceful and law abiding citizens.

There are no Yugoslavian organizations of any kind
in Shanghai.

Messrs. Ryabine and Bechich are of the opinion that
there is no reason to expect demonstrations or any other
undesirable activities on the part of their nationals in
Shanghai in connection with the Marseilles tragedy.

A. Prokofiev
D. S. I.

Officer i/c Special Branch.
[Signature]
For
Information
[Signature]
The Protection

日期：1934年10月14日。

上海公共租界工部局警务处
档案号 S. B. REGISTRY.
编号 D 6178

主题（全称）本地南斯拉夫社群——就亚历山大国王遇刺一事，其国民是否可能举行反意大利或反法国示威活动。

制作人：侦探副督察普罗科菲耶夫（Prokofiev） 转呈人 [签名]

10月13日下午1时，被视作本地南斯拉夫社群非正式代表的 J.P. 里亚比内（J.P. Ryabine）博士和贝奇奇（Bechich）先生接受了卑职的问询，以查明其在上海的国民是否会因南斯拉夫亚历山大国王遇刺一事而举行任何具有反意大利或反法国性质的示威活动。

他们表示，在上海的南斯拉夫人总数（包括妇女和儿童）不超过50人，且除少数例外，这些人均极为贫困。他们也是和平守法的公民。

上海没有任何形式的南斯拉夫组织。

里亚比内先生和贝奇奇先生认为，没有理由预期其在上海的国民会因马赛惨案而举行示威或进行其他不良活动。

A. 普罗科菲耶夫
侦探副督察

特科主管警官。

Date. October 11th 1934

Subject (in full) Requiem Mass in Memory of the Late King Alexander of
Yugo-Slavia at the Russian Orthodox Church.

Made by D.S.I. Prokofiev. Forwarded by （签名）

At 7.30 p.m. to-day a Requiem Mass in memory of the
late King Alexander of Yugo-Slavia will be celebrated at the
Russian Orthodox church ,No 55 Route Paul Henry .

All Russian public organizations have requested the
presence of their members at the mass,and it is expected that
a very large number of members of the Russian community will
attend the service.

G. Prokofiev
D.S.I.

Officer i/c Special Branch.

主题（全称）在俄罗斯东正教堂为已故南斯拉夫亚历山大国王举行安魂弥撒。

制作人：侦探副督察普罗科菲耶夫。 转呈人 （签名）

今晚7时30分，将在保罗亨利路55号（Route Paul Henry No 55）的俄罗斯东正教堂为已故南斯拉夫亚历山大国王举行安魂弥撒。

所有俄罗斯公共团体均已要求其成员出席该弥撒，预计将有大量俄侨社区成员参加此次礼拜仪式。

G. 普罗科菲耶夫
侦探副督察

特科主管警官。

THE NORTH-CHINA DAILY NEWS, MONDAY, NOVEMBER 5, 1934

London, Oct. 13.
Films showing the assassination of King Alexander and M. Barthou were being shown in London within three days of the crime. Actually, a friend who has seen them tells me, they do not show much, at least not too much. But only the police were allowed to see the whole film, in case they might identify a suspect in the crowd. The most ghastly parts were cut out.
The first parts show King Alexander arriving at Marseilles, that, of course, is the ordinary news-cinema work, as also is a "shot" taken just before the murder, in which the King is seen bowing and waving to the crowd. It is everywhere remarked that, in this scene, the mounted escort seem to be riding a considerable way behind the car, a fact on which, no doubt, the angry French public will pounce.
Then comes the assassination, the clearest part of which is Colonel Piollet slashing at the murderer. Wild disorder immediately ensues as the crowd rush round the car and that's practically all.
It is said that an amateur cinematographer happened to be on the spot, and immediately sold his film to one of the big professional companies, though not before he had spontaneously given it up to the police. He must have had an extraordinary nerve, to keep his camera working. Some of the snapshots published in newspapers are enough for me.

（批：S.C. (Br.)
Information.

《字林西报》，1934年11月5日，星期一

伦敦，10月13日电。
展示亚历山大国王和巴尔杜先生（M. Barthou）遇刺情形的影片，在罪行发生后的三天内便在伦敦放映。实际上，一位看过这些影片的朋友告诉我，影片显示的内容并不多，至少不算太多。但只有警方被允许观看完整影片，以便他们或许能识别出人群中的嫌疑人。最恐怖的部分已被剪除。
影片的开头部分显示亚历山大国王抵达马赛，这当然是普通的新闻电影素材，同样属于此类的是在谋杀发生前一刻拍摄的“镜头”，其中可见国王向人群鞠躬挥手。人们普遍注意到，在这一场景中，骑马护卫队似乎落在汽车后方相当一段距离，这一事实无疑会引发愤怒的法国民众的口诛笔伐。
接着是刺杀场面，其中最清晰的部分是皮奥莱上校（Colonel Piollet）挥刀砍向凶手。随即陷入一片混乱，人群涌向汽车周围，至此基本上就是全部画面了。
据说，一名业余摄影师恰好在现场，并立即将他的胶片卖给了一家大型专业公司，尽管在此之前他已自发将其交给警方。他能保持摄像机继续运转，必定拥有非凡的胆量。报纸上刊登的一些快照对我而言已经足够了。

（批注：S.C. (Br.)
